title: crossandra infundibuliformis subsp. brachystachys
intro: Crossandra infundibuliformis subsp. brachystachys, commonly known as the Red Breasted or Purple Passion flower, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Crossandra infundibuliformis subsp. brachystachys include anti-diarrheal, anti-spasmodic, and anti-microbial activities, which make it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal issues and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to possess significant health-promoting properties.
